ev.q: During August 7--November 7, 2000, 1087 suspected case-patients were identified, including 121 (11%) persons who died.
Of 490 case-patients with serologic testing, 136 (26%) had IgM-class antibody to RVF virus
Of the 1087, 815 (75%) case-patients reported exposure to sick animals
